children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) -
Excellon Resources Inc.
(OTCQB: EXNRF) (FSE: E4X2)
Excellon
" or the "
Company
") is pleased to announce that the Company has filed and mailed the management information circular (the "
Circular
") and related materials for the annual and special meeting (the "
Meeting
") of shareholders of Excellon ("
Excellon Shareholders

") to be held on December 16, 2026. The Company is also proposing to change its name to Excellon Silver & Gold Inc., subject to shareholder and regulatory approval. At the Meeting, among other things, Excellon Shareholders will be asked to consider and vote on a special resolution (the "
Arrangement Resolution
") approving a statutory plan of arrangement pursuant to section 182 of the
Business Corporations Act
(Ontario) (the "
Arrangement
"), subject to the terms and conditions of an arrangement agreement dated November 10, 2026 (the "
Arrangement Agreement
") entered into between Excellon and Saxony Silver Corp. ("
Saxony
"), a majority-owned subsidiary of Excellon, all as more particularly described in the Circular.
The board of directors of Excellon (the "
Excellon Board

") has unanimously determined that the transactions contemplated by the Arrangement are fair to Excellon Shareholders and are in the best interests of Excellon and the Excellon Shareholders. Accordingly, the Excellon Board has unanimously approved the Arrangement and unanimously recommends that Excellon Shareholders vote FOR the Arrangement Resolution. See pages 38 to 39 of the Circular for a detailed description of the "
Reasons for the Recommendation of the Excellon Board

In accordance with the interim order granted by the Ontario Superior Court of Justice (Commercial List) on November 16, 2026, providing for the calling and holding of the Meeting and other procedural matters relating to the Arrangement, the Arrangement can only proceed if, among other conditions, it receives the approval of not less than two-thirds (66⅔%) of the votes cast on the Arrangement Resolution by Excellon Shareholders in person (virtually) or by proxy at the Meeting.

Under the Arrangement Agreement, the parties have agreed to effect the Arrangement, pursuant to which, among other things, Excellon will assign and transfer approximately 44,145,632 common shares in the capital of Saxony ("
Saxony Shares
") that will be held by it on a post-share split basis to Excellon Shareholders,
pro rata
to the number of common shares in the capital of Excellon held by them. Excellon Shareholders will retain their proportionate ownership in Excellon.

As a result of, and immediately following the completion of, the Arrangement, the Excellon Shareholders will directly own approximately 48.0% of the Saxony Shares and Excellon will retain approximately 19.9% of the Saxony Shares, in each case on an undiluted basis.
Saxony has applied to list the Saxony Shares on the TSX Venture Exchange (the "
TSXV

"). Listing of the Saxony Shares on the TSXV will be subject to Saxony fulfilling all of the initial listing requirements of the TSXV. It is a condition to the completion of the Arrangement that the Saxony Shares shall have been approved for listing on the TSXV. However, there can be no assurance that the Saxony Shares will be listed on the TSXV.
Meeting and Circular
The Meeting of the Excellon Shareholders will be held virtually through the platform of AGM Connect at

at 10:00 a.m. (Toronto time) on December 16, 2026. Excellon Shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 16, 2026 are entitled to receive notice of and to vote at the Meeting. Excellon Shareholders are urged to vote before the proxy deadline of 10:00 a.m. (Toronto time) on December 14, 2026.

The Circular provides important information on the Arrangement and related matters, including the reasons for the recommendation made by the Excellon Board, and voting procedures. Excellon Shareholders are urged to read the Circular and its schedules and exhibits carefully and in their entirety. The Circular is being mailed to Excellon Shareholders in compliance with applicable Canadian securities laws. The Circular is available under Excellon's profile on SEDAR+ at
and on Excellon's website at
Saxony Silver Technical Report

In connection with the filing of the Circular, Excellon has also filed an independent technical report entitled "Silver City Project, Saxony, Germany, NI 43-101 Technical Report" dated September 16, 2026 with an effective date of August 31, 2026, prepared by Michael J. Robertson, Pr.Sci. Nat., MAusIMM, Principal Consultant of The MSA Group (Pty) Ltd. A copy of the technical report is available under Excellon's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca and on Excellon's website at www.excellonresources.com.
Proposed Change of Name
The Company is also pleased to announce that it intends to change its name from "Excellon Resources Inc." to "Excellon Silver & Gold Inc." (the "
Proposed Change of Name

"). At the Meeting, Excellon Shareholders will be asked to consider and, if deemed advisable, pass a special resolution authorizing an amendment to the articles of the Company to effect the Proposed Change of Name. The Company is seeking to effect the Proposed Change of Name to better reflect the Company's focus on advancing silver and gold assets, particularly the Mallay Mine and Tres Cerros Exploration Property in Peru, while preserving the established Excellon identity. The Proposed Change of Name is subject to regulatory approval, including, but not limited to, approval of the TSXV.
About Excellon Resources Inc.

Excellon Resources is focused on advancing the restart of its fully permitted, past-producing Mallay Silver-Lead-Zinc Mine in Peru, positioning the Company as a near-term silver producer. Following its February 2026 independent mineral resource estimate at Mallay, Excellon is advancing restart planning and near-mine growth, while also advancing the adjacent Tres Cerros Gold-Silver Exploration Property in Peru. The Company also holds the Kilgore Project, an advanced gold exploration project in Idaho, and the Silver City Project, a high-grade epithermal silver district in Saxony, Germany. Additional details on Excellon's properties can be found at www.excellonresources.com.
About Saxony Silver Corp.

Saxony Silver is a European-focused silver exploration company, which is underpinned by a district-scale land package in a historically prolific silver-producing region. Saxony Silver holds a 100% interest in the Silver City Project, which is a high-grade epithermal silver-zinc-lead exploration project located in the Freiberg mining district of Saxony, Germany. The Silver City Project covers four exploration licenses totaling approximately 340 km2 (34,000 hectares).
